hero.headline:
Enterprise Solution Architecture and
Agent-Based AI Transformation
hero.description: Customer-embedded implementation leader who runs discovery, designs solutions, and architects integrations for enterprise SaaS customers, then builds the AI agents that make delivery repeatable. Experienced in turning customer requirements into actionable designs, designing agents and skills around each customer's use cases, and delivering on-site workshops and go-lives across the UK, US, and Middle East.

experience.title: AI Implementation Manager
bullets: Own customer implementations end to end on Rocketlane's professional services automation platform (discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-live) as implementation manager, solution architect, and engagement manager.
Implement Nitro, Rocketlane's agentic AI platform, for customers, designing and deploying agents around each customer's own use cases.
Built the Nitro agents Rocketlane's implementation team now uses across the project lifecycle, as part of the Customer Zero team that adopts every Nitro release first and feeds back to product.

Built Atlas, an AI knowledge system that records how each customer's use cases were solved, so any implementation manager can ask how a problem was handled before and get an answer that is still current.
Solution architect and implementation manager for Phase 2 of NICE, an enterprise account, integrating Rocketlane with ADP, SatMetrix, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.

highlights.label: Nitro · Agents the team runs on
highlights.text:
Agents: sales-to-implementation handover, kickoff decks, workshop planner (prep and recap), solution design documents, UAT scripts and cases, and form-to-Sheets reporting.
Context built in: they run inside the Rocketlane project where documents, meetings and transcripts already live, so there’s less pulling from Avoma and other sources.
Estimated 20–30% less time per deliverable.
Consistent output: standardised formats replace individual templates, so results are clearer and repeatable.

highlights.label: Atlas · AI Implementation Knowledge System
highlights.text:
Problem: Implementation knowledge was scattered across team members, call transcripts, and unstructured documents, resulting in repeated problem-solving and limited reuse of previously developed solutions.
Solution:
- Use-Case Extraction & Solution Generation: An Anthropic-hosted agent analyzes Avoma call transcripts and Freshdesk tickets to identify customer use cases and capture solutions discussed. When no solution was discussed, it proposes one using product documentation.
- Human Review: Implementation Managers review, approve, or revise generated use cases and solutions before they are added to the reusable knowledge base.
- Intelligent Retrieval: A backend agent built in Lovable, powered by custom skills, uses Supermemory to retrieve relevant approved solutions and answer implementation questions without loading the entire documentation corpus into the LLM.
- Current-State Validation: Cross-checks historical solutions against Notion, Slack, Rocketlane projects, and product and API documentation to identify retired features and outdated approaches.
- Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Caches repeat answers at 95%+ relevance, captures user ratings, and routes incorrect answers through a validator agent for classification and admin review.
Impact: Reached 60–65% adoption across the Professional Services team, with approximately 10 queries per user per week and 70–80% reported usefulness. Helps Implementation Managers find answers independently rather than spending time tracking down colleagues.

highlights.label: Nitro · Configuration agent (POC)
highlights.text:
Problem: Native settings, notifications, and automations were configured manually after every design document.
Solution: Built a Nitro Workforce agent that reads design documents and determines the required configuration.
Browser Automation: Uses Browserbase to navigate Rocketlane, configure settings, and create automations.
Validation: Proof of concept subsequently validated by the product team.

experience.title: Lead, Product Implementation
bullets: Ran discovery workshops with executives and operations teams, turned requirements into BRDs, solution designs, and WBS-based plans, and configured and tested each rollout through go-live.
Led enterprise CMMS implementations for mid-to-large clients across the UK, US, and Middle East, with $4.1M+ in total contract value and nearly $1M in implementation and expansion value.

highlights.label: Key initiative
highlights.text: Built a use-case-driven implementation framework with complexity scoring and effort models — so pre-sales could scope accurately, auto-calculate timelines, and cut BRD and UAT ambiguity.

highlights.label: Global delivery
highlights.text: On-site in Saudi Arabia for a half-million-dollar engagement and in the UK for MHA — requirement gathering, stakeholder workshops, and go-live training.

highlights.label: Pilot → Enterprise conversions
highlights.text: Converted pilots into full-scale enterprise rollouts through structured discovery and early value demonstration — $350K+ in expansion value.

highlights.label: Revenue impact
highlights.text: Spotted unbilled scope changes, built a way to track them, and worked with Sales to introduce pre-purchased Professional Services credits — turning informal changes into billable work.

highlights.label: AI Config Assistant · Enterprise support tool
highlights.text:
Problem: Implementation engineers spent about 3 hours a week each (2–6 hours) supporting the support team on issues, even with a solution document in place. The platform is fully customizable and implementations run 6 months to a year, so configurations change constantly.
Solution: An AI assistant using RAG and NLP over XML platform configurations, so support teams can ask configuration questions in natural language.
Impact: Support teams get configuration answers themselves, removing their dependency on implementation engineers after go-live – aimed at the roughly 3 hours a week (2–6) each implementation resource spent.

experience.title: Senior Catalog Specialist
bullets: Designed a defect prioritisation framework using product forecasts, inventory value, and glance views, yielding an estimated $230K in monthly savings.
Streamlined defect reduction by identifying SOP gaps, reducing invalid case assignments between support teams by ~50 per day.
Managed and resolved catalog and procurement defects for Amazon Fresh, Amazon Pantry, and Prime Now, directly improving operational efficiency.

projects.name: Atlas
projects.description: Reusable AI solution knowledge built from customer calls, tickets, Slack, and project docs, with human approval of every solution. Answers are checked against current product knowledge so retired features don't resurface, and answers marked wrong are classified by a validator agent and routed to an admin review queue.

projects.name: AI Config Assistant
projects.description: AI-powered assistant that lets support teams query enterprise platform configurations in natural language, removing the dependency on implementation engineers after go-live.

projects.name: FAAX
projects.description: Agent-based platform where users define structured trading blueprints. AI monitors conditions, generates setups, and drafts trades for human approval, with risk management built in.

summary: Solution architect and implementation leader who owns enterprise SaaS engagements from discovery to go-live and designs the AI agents that make them reusable. At Rocketlane, implements the Nitro agentic AI platform around each customer's own use cases, architects enterprise integrations with Salesforce, ServiceNow, ADP, and SatMetrix, and built Atlas and the Nitro agents the implementation team runs on. At Facilio, led enterprise CMMS rollouts across the UK, US, and Middle East, with $4.1M+ in total contract value and nearly $1M in implementation and expansion value.
